decision.question: Should the founder commit six weeks to building the MVP now?
decision.objective: Maximize expected venture value while preserving runway and option value.

options.label: Commit six weeks to build MVP

beliefs.statement: ICP has a severe recurring problem
ICP will pay at least EUR 500/month
Founder can reach 20 ICPs in two weeks

evidence.claim: 16 of 20 interviews described the pain as severe
0 of 4 qualified prospects accepted a EUR 500 paid pilot

experiments.name: Sell a paid concierge pilot
experiments.description: Offer the promised outcome manually before building product.
experiments.success_signal: At least one ICP pays >= EUR 500.
experiments.failure_signal: No qualified ICP accepts payment after a predefined sales sample.

experiments.name: Run problem interviews
experiments.description: Interview qualified ICPs about current workflow and pain.
experiments.success_signal: Repeated severe pain with concrete current workaround.
experiments.failure_signal: Pain is infrequent or low priority.

experiments.name: Run ICP outreach test
experiments.description: Attempt to reach a fixed sample of qualified ICPs.
